searchText: ok. even so, after doing some kurtosis setup where one of the CLs didn't broadcast columns, so its blocks depended 100% req/resp (3 CLs, only one of them Nimbus), it falls apart quickly so I'm keeping this in Nimbus until this can be fixed more robustly in a way I trust and is tested what I can do is try to get it not to rebroadcast it, but that's a separate point to some degree. i.e. what I won't do is make it depend on req/resp, that obviously isn't working (in general) What do you mean by "it falls apart"? The network falls apart? Or the slots of that validator are missed? network it's effectively nonfunctional, all 3 CLs
